text:
If you're heading out this evening, keep an eye on the sky, there's still a shot of a shower or rumble of thunder before 10, but it should wind down after that, leaving a muggy, mostly cloudy night with the low only dipping to around 71. The lake's calming down too, winds easing to light and variable overnight after that gusty southwest breeze this afternoon.

Tomorrow's the pick of this stretch: mostly sunny and warm with a high near 88, though the heat index will make it feel more like the mid-90s, so plan your shade and water accordingly. Air quality creeps to moderate up north as a heads up for anyone sensitive to smoke or ozone. Enjoy the sunshine while it lasts, because showers and thunderstorms return after midnight into Friday night, some capable of heavy rain, and that wetter, stormier pattern sticks around into the weekend. I'd get outdoor plans done by early evening Friday and keep the rain jacket handy for Saturday.
